objectives.decoded: {sc}Go to the City of Torc'qua and destroy Lord Jadoth.{sc}Go to Ravenheart Gloom and destroy the Greater Darkness.{sc}Go to the Foundry of Failed Creations and destroy the Fury.{sc}Go to the Stygian Veil and destroy the Dreadspawn Maw.{sc}Report your success in defeating the Lords of Anguish to High Priest Zhellix.{s}Speak to High Priest Zhellix to commence the assault on the Ebony Citadel of Mallyx the Unyielding.

name: {sc}Go to the City of Torc'qua and destroy Lord Jadoth.{sc}Go to Ravenheart Gloom and destroy the Greater Darkness.{sc}Go to the Foundry of Failed Creations and destroy the Fury.{sc}Go to the Stygian Veil and destroy the Dreadspawn Maw.{sc}Report your success in defeating the Lords of Anguish to High Priest Zhellix.{s}Speak to High Priest Zhellix to commence the assault on the Ebony Citadel of Mallyx the Unyielding.

[Difficulty: Master] To defeat Mallyx the Unyielding, we must break into his Ebony Citadel. However, it will not be quite so simple as just knocking on his tower door. Mallyx the Unyielding has four great servants...the General, the Fury, the Greater Darkness, and the Dreadspawn Maw...known collectively as the overlords.

These are all powerful beings unto themselves, and the four of them together would surely overwhelm any force seeking to gain entrance. Our only hope lies in destroying the overlords before attempting to confront Mallyx. If you somehow manage to defeat these overlords, return to me and we will begin preparations for a strike on the Ebony Citadel. Reward:30,000 Experience2,000 Gold2,000 Lightbringer PointsMargonite GemstoneStygian GemstoneTitan GemstoneTorment Gemstone
